text: Contractor crane operator at Digboi lifted a defective hydraulic valve with wire rope under tension, PTW expired, no spotter. Worker trapped hand in sheave, laceration required 12 stitches, sent to hospital.

During scaffold erection at Lumding Terminal, a 3m steel tube slipped from 4th level while being passed. Worker standing below ducked, tube struck shoulder, soft tissue injury treated with ice and painkillers on site.
Employee at Naharkatiya was working on valve stand height 6m. Sling bag broke due to UV damage, ABL broke. Worker fell 3m onto hard ground, fractured left radius, admitted for surgery.

Crane lift of heavy piping at Duliajan, wind gust 40km/h. Load swung wide, missed working area by 2ft. No PTW revamp for high wind, supervisor missed report. Worker nearly hit, checked for shock, released.
Hot work permit violated at Rangia. Welder at height dropped torch handle from 5m. Struck bare foot of inspector below, deep cut, blood flow controlled, tetanus booster given, clinic visit.
At Guwahati Depot, forklift tried to lift steel beam without sling, forklift tipped 15deg. Operator jumped out in time, arm grazed on metal edge. First aid applied, X-ray clear, no fracture.
Scaffolder at Moran site used broken plank from 2nd level. Plank snapped, worker fell 3m but caught himself on lower frame. Sprained wrist, monitored for 2 hours, discharged same day.

Crane at Jorhat Bypass Road lifted pump assembly. Hook block descended unexpectedly due to hydraulic leak, 500kg load dropped 2m onto concrete. Worker nearby stepped back, dust inhalation, mild bronchitis, treated with syrup.
Employee at Digboi used extension ladder without lockout tagout to reach valve. Ladder slipped on wet surface, worker fell 2m, dislocated shoulder. Reduced in ER, stable, 1 week off work.

During hoisting at Naharkatiya, tag line failed, load rotated. Flange corner grazed shoulder of crew member, abrasion and bruising. Wound cleaned and bandaged at site clinic, no further treatment needed.
Contractor welding on 6" line at Duliajan without proper blanking. Sparks ignited nearby oil leak, worker on ground got flash burn to forearms, treated at camp clinic.
Grinding flange on Digboi tank farm, ventilation poor. Operator inhaled fumes, coughing and dizziness, sent to Guwahati hospital for observation. PTW had gas test old.
During hot work on Naharkatiya separator, pressure gauge needle jerked. Oil spray hit face of supervisor. No eye injury but skin irritation, first aid insufficient, referred to local doctor.
Cutting pipe at Moran wellhead, cutter slipped and hit wrist. Deep laceration, stitched at site hospital. H2S alarm not sounding, area cleared but work stopped.
Welding near storage tanks at Lumding Terminal. Heat stress suspected, worker fainted near standpipe. Rehydrated and monitored. No thermal burns, but medical attention required beyond basic kit.
Sanding rust at Guwahati Depot pipeline. Respirator mask strap broke, dust inhaled. Worker complained of breathing difficulty, sent to clinic for nebulization treatment. Not just first aid.
Night shift at Rangia, grinding valve body. Spark flew into eye protection. Grit in eye, persistent pain. Specialized ophthalmic wash needed, not standard eye wash. Categorized as recordable.
Brazing coupling on Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline. Contractor used wrong filler rod, joint failed. Hot metal splatter burned hand. Blisters formed, antiseptic dressing and antibiotics prescribed.
Thermal cutting at Duliajan, debris flew out of containment. Hit leg of nearby worker. Abrasion and bruising, no fracture but required tetanus booster and dressing.
Hot work in Digboi module, confined space entry. Worker felt dizzy from heat, exited and collapsed. Dehydration severe, IV fluids administered at site medical unit. Not minor first aid.

Confound H2S detector alarm during tank entry at Duliajan, gas source unidentified but concentration spiked to 100ppm, entry team aborted immediately, potential asphyxiation avoided due to early detection.
Worker entered Digboi sump without valid PTW, found high level of liquid near bottom, slippery conditions with no anti-slip footwear, high risk of fall and drowning, PTW violation confirmed.

At Naharkatiya, contractor personnel entered vessel with only single LOTO applied, power isolation was incomplete for agitator drive, sudden activation possible, no lockout verification checklist completed.
During night shift at Moran, confined space entry permit expired 15 mins before entry, continuous monitoring not running, toxic atmosphere potential undetected, safeguard failure.
Lumding Terminal tank entry attempted with venting not completed, residual hydrocarbon vapors present, static discharge hazard from clothing, ignition source not controlled.
Employee at Guwahati Depot entered manhole without buddy system, single person entry in dark area, no communication device functional, rescue capability absent.
Rangia tank farm, contractor team entered storage tank for cleaning, no atmospheric test within 30 mins prior to entry, oxygen levels could have dropped below safe limit unnoticed.

Jorhat Bypass Road pump station, sump entry carried out without proper PPE, worker wore regular shoes in oily environment, slip and fall onto submerged obstacles likely to cause severe laceration or fracture.
At Duliajan, vessel entry for inspection, gas analyzer calibrated 24 hours ago, drift error possible, high pressure system not fully depressurized, stored energy release hazard.
Digboi depot, tank entry permit shared with another crew, no dedicated standby person, weather turned rainy reducing visibility, rescue access blocked by flooding, isolation integrity compromised.

5T crawler crane lifting spool piece at Duliajan, tag line not attached during swing. Load drifted 2m over walkway where two workers were standing. No PTW for hot work nearby but wind picked up suddenly. Near miss, no injury.

Morning shift at Naharkatiya, mobile crane operator spotting pipe rack. Shackle pin not fully engaged in hook. Load dropped 30cm onto steel beam. Heavy thud heard, sway in area. H2S detector normal. No personnel under load at impact.

Contractor team using 25T truck crane at Moran. Rigging sling cut by sharp edge on flange during hoist. Load tilted, tag line snapped. Operator lowered slowly. SIF potential realized but no contact with ground or people. Weather clear.

Night shift Digboi, lifting pump casing across fence line. Wind gust pushed load into exclusion zone fencing. Fencing bent, load stopped 1m before office window. No shatter. LOTO in place on adjacent unit but not relevant. Near miss recorded.

Lumding Terminal, tanker offloading area. Forklift lifting cage of valves. Operator distracted by radio call, tilted load over pedestrian path. Two marshals stepped back instinctively. No tag line used incorrectly. No injury, high risk of crushing if they stayed.

Guwahati Depot, receiving new spare parts. Crane hook blocked by debris during descent. Load swung violently against storage rack. Rack shifted, boxes fell. No one in drop zone as per SWL check, but proximity was <1m. Wind calm.

Rangia refinery, unit 3 revamp. Overhead crane moving valve body. Brake failed momentarily, load dropped 0.5m. Slings stretched, load hit platform edge. Sparks flew, no fire. Workers in LOTO area looked up. Clear PSIF scenario avoided.

Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline expansion. Mini-crane lifting valve. Operator sightlines blocked by fuel tank trailer. Load swung into trailer frame. Metal on metal shriek. No personnel within radius, but tag line operator was 5m away. Near miss, high energy movement.

Duliajan, jetty area. Waverider lifting hose reel. Wind increased to 45km/h. Load could not be controlled, swung into loading arm. Hose arm fractured. No staff on jetty at that moment due to tides. Warnings issued, wind hold implemented.

Naharkatiya, compressor house. A-frame derrick lifting gas meter. Shackle slipped from one leg due to corrosion. Load fell 2m onto concrete pad. Dust cloud. No one working under, but inspector was 3m away observing. SIF potential, no injury.
Contractor found unisolated line with residual pressure during maintenance at Duliajan. Valve was closed but PTW did not specify LOTO. No injury reported, line purged immediately.
Employee attempted to remove cover on Digboi pump skid without verifying zero energy. Stored spring tension caused slight movement. Equipment isolated after near miss event.
During night shift at Naharkatiya, isolated section released unexpected burst of gas. SIF interlock failed to engage. No personnel exposed due to rain and distance.
Lumding Terminal loader arm locked out incorrectly. Hydraulic pressure remained in cylinders during hose change. Contractor near miss, no injury, re-verified energy isolation.
Residual H2S detected at Moran wellhead after TBT completion. Isolation flange not properly packed. Alert raised, area evacuated, no exposure recorded.
Guwahati Depot storage tank gauge line had trapped pressure. Employee tightened bolt without bleeding off line. Near miss recorded, procedure violated, no injury.
Rangia compressor pack-out revealed unisolated instrument air line. Whistle noise startled team. No injury, LOTO tag missing, corrective action initiated.
Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline tie-in showed unexpected flow. Isolation valves were locked but bypass was open. Near miss, no injury, work stopped for review.
Duliajan flare cooler had residual heat and pressure. Contractor touched blind flange, causing steam release. No burn, equipment fully isolated after incident.
Digboi block valve stuck open during LOTO verification. Hydraulic pump tripped unexpectedly. Employee stepped back in time, no injury, TBT failed.

Night shift operator at pump station found with strong alcohol smell near SIF valve. Worker reported dizziness but no impact on equipment. Supervisor escorted off site and incident logged as near miss.
Contractor found snoring in control room during day shift. H2S alarm was testing fine but operator was unresponsive for 2 mins. No gas release detected during this period.
Driver of fuel tanker was dozing off on stand 3 at midnight. Vehicle moved 5 meters before hydraulic brakes engaged. No spillage or fire risk achieved.
Employee tested positive for cannabis during random pre-shift check. Individual refused to enter restricted area and was sent home. No operational impact caused.
PTW holder under influence of sedatives while verifying LOTO status. Tool dropped from 4m height but missed the tank farm below. Close call recorded.
Technician complained of headache and slurred speech during maintenance. He stepped away from live electrical panel immediately on advice. No electrocution risk materialized.
Contract staff member found with alcohol bottle in locker during morning rounds. Worker claimed it was for personal use but not consumed on site. No impairment observed during work.
Operator at compressor station was found napping near high-pressure manifold. Safety interlock was active preventing any unintended start. No injury or leak occurred.
Driver of maintenance truck was sleepy on bumpy terrain. Vehicle swerved slightly toward barricade but stayed within lane. No collision or damage reported.
Employee displayed signs of intoxication while handling flammable liquid drum. Spill was minor and contained within tray. No ignition source present during the event.

During planned isolation of 6" process line, blind flange failed to seat due to worn gasket, causing high pressure steam jet towards open area. PTW incomplete for energy source verification. Contractor team standing within 3m radius had seconds to evacuate, near fatal exposure potential.

While bolting flange on high-pressure hydrocarbon line, sudden release of H2S gas occurred due to incorrect blind plug alignment. Wind from NE pushed gas towards two employees standing close. Tox release potential high, no face shields or SCBA worn by nearby personnel.

Break in 4" fuel gas line during maintenance caused massive flare and fireball. Two technicians working on adjacent valve were fully exposed to thermal radiation. SIF trip failed to isolate section. Potential for severe burns and fatalities if they had not ducked behind equipment.

Removal of restriction orifice in 1.5" line resulted in water hammer effect, breaking flange connection. Debris and high velocity fluid sprayed across work zone. Worker in direct line of fire, potential for amputation or eye loss. LOTO procedure bypassed for speed.

During commissioning of new pipeline spool, pressure test failed at flange joint. High pressure jet cut through PPE and struck contractor's leg. Intense pain reported, immediate need for hospitalisation. Significant blood loss potential. Safety watchman absent from isolation point.

Gasket crush in 10" crude line caused uncontrolled release of crude oil and vapors under pressure. Flammable mist ignited near hot work permit area. Worker handling torch within blast radius. Potential for immediate fatality due to flash fire injury and smoke inhalation.

While cutting live line for modification, wrong valve was isolated. Line pressurised unexpectedly, breaking small bore connection. High pressure jet injected into skin of operator. Severe deep tissue injury risk. PTW scope did not cover this specific isolation point.

Blind flange rotated during bolt tightening on high-pressure steam header. Steam burst out at 300 deg C. Door of nearby utility room shattered. Two supervisors inside room, potential for third-degree burns and asphyxiation. Ventilation system offline.

Lost flange bolts on 8" gas line led to separation of ends. Gas cloud formed rapidly around digging trench. Worker in trench had no egress under gas overpressure. Potential for explosion and burial. Gas detector alarm faulty.

Failure of gasket during pressure cycling test caused rupture. Debris and fluid stream hit scaffolding leg, collapsing it. Worker on 15ft platform fell towards active process equipment. Potential for crush injury or fall from height onto hard surface. No fall arrest gear used.
Rigger crushed between suspended pipe spool and ground during lift at Duliajan. Head impact fatal. Shift 2, heavy rain reducing visibility.
Scaffold plank fractured under load at Moran, dropping 50kg wrench to ground below. Worker standing below suffered head laceration, admitted to hospital. Contractor crew, PTW valid.
Worker fell 12m from tank roof at Lumding Terminal due to missing anchorage point. Leg fracture and spinal injury sustained. Employee, night shift, foggy conditions.
Crane outrigger settled on soft ground at Naharkatiya, tipping 2-ton load onto vehicle. Driver trapped, extricated with severe crush injuries to lower limbs. Hospitalized immediately.
Suspended load swung uncontrolled at Digboi, striking gantry support. Worker on platform struck by debris, suffered compound fracture of arm. Contractor, morning shift, clear weather.
Falling scaffold tube at Rangia hit worker in face, causing orbital blowout and deep lacerations. Required surgical intervention. Employee, shift 1, windy conditions.
Rigging failed during heavy lift at Guwahati Depot, dropping 300kg flange. Worker standing in exclusion zone struck, fatal skull fracture. No LOTO applied, high energy release.
Worker slipped from ladder at Jorhat Bypass Road while securing suspended valve. Fell 6m onto paved surface, broken pelvis and bleeding from ears. Admitted to trauma center.
Scaffold collapse at Duliajan during assembly phase, worker pinned under cross-bracing. Thoracic vertebra fracture incurred. Contractor, afternoon, high humidity.
Hook rolled over during lift at Naharkatiya, dropping valve pack onto worker's shoulder. Massive soft tissue damage and clavicle fracture. Hospitalized, PTW expired but work continued.
Vehicle reversing on lease road without spotter, struck worker knee, ankle sprain treated in field clinic.
Tractor operating at night, animal collision caused driver to lose control, bruising on abdomen, X-ray negative.
Fatigued operator speeding on curved section, skid hit barrier, mild shoulder dislocation, referred to Guwahati hospital.
Reversing water tanker, rear bumper clipped employee heel, laceration required stitches.
High speed on wet road during rain, vehicle hydroplaned, driver experienced whiplash, neck pain, medical observation.
Conveyor truck backing up, worker stepped back, crushed foot, toe fracture, ambulance transported to Rangia hospital.
Vehicle parked on shoulder with hazard lights off, pickup reversing, impact on leg, mid-shin fracture, splinted at site.
Day time, crossing rail track, vehicle stuck, worker pulling loose cable, hand caught, tendon injury, irrigation required.
Worker walking on lease road, pickup reversing, wheel grazed shin, deep abrasion, tetanus shot and antibiotics.
Heavy vehicle turning, worker outside clear zone, struck by exhaust stack, chest contusion, rib pain, CT scan cleared.
Scaffold plank slipped from second level at Duliajan pump station, narrowly missed operator walking below. No PTW violation observed but housekeeping was poor. Worker was wearing hard hat.
Ladder rung gave way on Digboi flare stack, worker caught himself on rail. Near fall from 4m height. LOTO was active but safety harness was not hooked off.
Contractor lost balance on Lumding Terminal tank roof, caught edge with hand. Slip hazard due to rain. No injury reported but potential for PSIF given unprotected edge.
Guy wire snapped on Naharkatiya derrick, missed driller standing nearby. Wind speed was high but work continued. No fall arrest system deployed at the time.
Roof sheeting shifted during removal at Guwahati Depot, worker held onto pipe rack. Loose material fell from 6m. PPE was compliant but coordination was lacking.
Scaffold lift basket tilted slightly at Rangia, operator inside felt unstable. Hydraulic leak suspected. Work stopped immediately, no personnel below in zone.
Worker slipped on oil spill on Jorhat Bypass Road platform, jumped to lower level. Landed on feet, no fracture. H2S monitor was not active on this level.
Broken ladder rung found during inspection at Moran, worker was ascending. Turned back immediately. Old equipment being used without tag-out. Near miss recorded.
Pipe fell from scaffold at Duliajan, hit guard rail then ground. Missed valve operator by 1 metre. No dual points of attachment used by contractor crew.
Roof access ladder detached at Digboi, worker on platform lost footing. Grabbed adjacent structure. No safety net below. TBT was not enforced for this task.
Contractor opened valve on line 12 without checking PTW validity, gas meter read 0 LEL because purging incomplete, close call no exposure.
Expired PTW for hot work found on Digboi plant 3, guard stopped welder before arc struck, sulfur smell detected nearby.
Gas test certificate forged for confined entry at Naharkatiya, supervisor caught mismatched signature, no one entered.
Night shift operator bypassed LOTO procedure at Moran, unexpected flow from upstream caused pressure spike, no injury but system tripped.
Missing gas test before breaking flange at Lumding Terminal, H2S detector alarm failed, worker smelled gas and retreated immediately.
PTW not cancelled after scope change at Guwahati Depot, fuel smell near electrical panel, near miss avoided due to static grounding kit nearby.
Valid PTW but missing isolation verification at Rangia, high pressure line isolated but blind flange not installed, valve leak detected during re-entry.
Contractor used expired hot work permit at Jorhat Bypass Road pump station, rain delayed testing, spark source identified before ignition.
Forged gas test log for tank entry at Duliajan, safety officer intercepted team, toxic levels found upon re-testing.
PTW skipped for minor maintenance at Digboi, valve packing failed causing hydrocarbon release, wind dispersed vapor before accumulation.
Crane operator at Digboi failed to keep load clear of personnel during slew, swinging bundle of pipes over a ladder where a rigging tech was standing, causing him to jump back and strain his ankle.
Shackle pin on tag line slipped off unsecured load at Duliajan, striking a supervisor falling from 10ft scaffolding; he sustained a fractured wrist and was treated at RSQ.
Boom of mobile crane at Naharkatiya dropped slightly during lift due to wind gust, causing a tag line to snap and whip around a worker's arm, resulting in lacerations requiring stitches.
Sling cut by sharp edge of valve flange at Moran, load shifted and pinned a fitter's hand against the block for 15 seconds before released; diagnosed with crushed fingers and swelling.
Tag line not attached by crane spotter at Lumding Terminal, causing 2-ton flange to drift into wind and hit a loading arm, shattering a control panel glass that grazed an operator's forehead.
Lifting beam overloaded at Guwahati Depot slipped off support blocks, dropping 6 inches and striking a contractor's shin as he walked underneath; swelling and bruising recorded as recordable injury.
Runner crane at Rangia failed to brake smoothly, load swung into pipe rack and struck a worker leaning on the rail, causing a dislocated shoulder and minor head contusion.
Improper rigging of heavy pump at Jorhat Bypass Road caused sling to burst while lifting, whipping a worker who was guiding the load with his hand, resulting in deep cuts on forearm.
Crane hook at Digboi fell from 30ft height due to latch failure, missing a crew member by 2ft and hitting the ground; shock and minor abrasions reported, but no direct impact injury.
Load shifted during transport by forklift at Duliajan, dropping a steel plate onto a driver's foot who was repositioning it without PTW; toe injury required X-ray and bandaging.

Employee found by supervisor at 04:30 hrs near pump house smelling of alcohol. First aid administered at site clinic for dizziness but patient refused further hospital transfer. Blood sample collected and posted for lab analysis. PTW for day shift suspended pending investigation.

Contractor operator involved in minor collision with forklift during off-road transfer. Immediate first aid given for head bump and abrasions. Medical officer assessed and recommended observation. Operator reported no drug use but field officer noted suspicious behavior during pre-shift check.

Operator delayed in entering control room after smoking break. Breathalyzer showed 0.08% alcohol level. Operator visited camp infirmary due to sudden vomiting. Incident recorded as recordable due to treatment beyond first aid. Assigned duties suspended immediately.

Worker found unconscious in abandoned hut near metering point at 22:00 hrs. Woken up by security team and taken to local hospital for IV fluids. Suspected intoxication due to consumption of local liquor. No physical injury other than mild dehydration recorded in medical report.

Driver of water tanker involved in fender bender on access track. Driver claimed fatigue but smell of alcohol detected during PTW check. Driver treated at site clinic for minor cuts on forehead. Vehicle immobilized and driver shifted to standby status. Lab test requested for impairment confirmation.

Maintenance crew member reported nausea and headache during scheduled maintenance. Suspected ingestion of prescribed medication without doctor advice or mixing with alcohol. First aid provided but symptoms persisted requiring medical evaluation at nearby hospital. TBT issued for breach of drug and alcohol policy.

Employee attempted to enter live area without proper PPE while under influence. Stopped by LOTO representative but exhibited aggressive behavior. Taken to clinic for stabilization due to raised blood pressure induced by stress and substance. No direct injury from process equipment but medical attention required beyond first aid.

Contractor fitter found unresponsive on platform of 10m height at 03:00 hrs. Rescued by rope team and given first aid for confusion and disorientation. Transported to hospital for observation. Preliminary test indicated presence of sedatives. Safety stand-down conducted for the crew.

Operator missed critical alarm response due to drowsiness. Later found to be under influence of over-the-counter cold medicine mixed with alcohol. Experienced mild hypotensive episode treated at site health desk. Immediate removal from critical role and notification to HSSE coordinator. Recordable injury due to medical treatment for vitals stabilization.

Vehicle operator involved in near collision at entry gate leading to sudden braking injury. Sprained ankle requiring splinting and X-ray at local clinic. Operator failed random alcohol test conducted post-incident. Duty suspended and case referred for disciplinary action. Medical certificate obtained for injury treatment.
Fuel tanker reversed on lease road without spotter, rear wheel passed within 0.5m of standing supervisor. No spotters deployed due to short shift change. PTW not updated for reversing ops.
Pickup vehicle crossed over centre line on foggy night near gate, near collision with oncoming dumper. Driver reported fatigue after 12hr shift. No injury but close call on narrow dirt road.
Cattle wandered onto access road, driver applied emergency brake causing truck to skid near embankment edge. Vehicle stopped 1m from slope. No impact but high risk of rollover.
Staff car oversped on bend, tyres lost grip and vehicle went onto shoulder. No barrier present. Vehicle stopped against tree. Occupants unbelted at time of event.
Water tanker driver distracted by mobile phone, missed bend and drove into soft patch. Vehicle tilted 45 deg. Occupants braced but no injury. No guardrail on that stretch.
Contractor tractor reversing blindly near equipment laydown area. Almost struck live cable reel. Alarm sounded but no speed limiter on vehicle. High energy potential if hit.
Monsoon rain reduced visibility. Bus driver braked suddenly on loose gravel, rear axle slipped off road edge. Vehicle stopped on incline. Passenger standing in aisle near exit door.
Fuel bowser entered closed section of road due to navigation error. Stopped 2m away from unmarked trench. No ground exploration done before entry. High risk of under-ride.
Night shift patrol vehicle moved fast on wet tarmac, hydroplaned and drifted across lane. Nearly clipped stationary tool crate. No sign of hazard present. Driver admitted to tiredness.
Loader operator reversing on lease road with poor lighting. Almost backed into pedestrian crossing road. No lights on vehicle rear. Pedestrian stood still in shock.

Contractor scaffold gang working at 10am in Duslik. Safety belt lanyard broke under load, worker dangled for 5 mins before rescue. Required stitches on back but no fracture. PTW was valid but inspection log missing for the harness.
Forklift lifting pipe rack at 1400 hrs. Load shifted due to wet mud, struck operator's leg. Swelling and bruising, treated in canteen clinic. No sling certified, operator untrained on load trim.
Scaffolder fell from 2nd level platform while moving cross-brace. Landing on dirt, fractured wrist. A-frame ladder not tied off, no spotter present. Rain in evening reduced grip.

Crane boom struck overhead 11kV line during lift in foggy morning. Arc flash exposed to rigger, minor burn on forearm. SIF tripped but clearance procedure ignored. Rigger required dressing, signed off same day.
Suspended load of valve body dropped 2m due to shackle pin withdrawal. Hit worker's shin, deep laceration. Splice not inspected, LOTO not applied on hoist. First aid applied, no X-ray needed.
Workman climbing manway fell 3m when bolt slipped. Hit knee hard on concrete pad. Pain and swelling, transported to civil hospital. No helmet, no belt. Weather windy, gusts reported.
EOT crane lifting transformer core. Rope snapped, core dropped 1m. Worker caught foot between core and beam. Crush injury, toe fracture. Weekly inspection report was fake, wire rope frayed visibly.
Transporter unloading steel pipes at 2200 hrs. Chain hoist failed, pipes rolled down slope. Worker tripped and fell, twisted ankle. Lighting poor, no banking for load. Treated at site infirmary.
During lifting/suspended load at Digboi, a worker slipped and injured his wrist. Hospital check found no fracture; treated and released with medication.
During lifting/suspended load at Digboi, a worker slipped and injured his wrist. Hospital check found no fracture; treated and released with medication.
Operator driving company jeep on lease road at 2200 hrs hit a stray cow. Driver ran over the animal and sustained multiple fractures. Unconscious on arrival, taken to hospital via air ambulance.
Contractor truck reversing near Digboi metering station without spotter. Vehicle struck the rear of a parked service van and crushed the attendant. Fatal head and chest injuries confirmed on scene.
Heavy rain reduced visibility on Naharkatiya access road. Forklift operator lost control while reversing near pipe rack. Machine tipped and pinned the operator's leg. Amputation below knee required.
Fatigued driver of fuel bowser oversped on curve near Moran. Vehicle left road and slammed into support pillar. Driver trapped and suffered severe spinal injury and internal bleeding.
Lorry unloading at Lumding Terminal slipped on wet surface. Trailer swung and struck the uncontrolled loading arm. Operator was 1m away when arm collapsed. Broken ribs and lacerations.

Station wagon driven by employee on Guwahati Depot apron. Sudden brake failure led to collision with concrete pillar at 40 kmph. Passenger sustained compartmentalised skull fracture. Critical condition in ICU.
Spotter for reversing dumper at Rangia fell while crossing road. Dumper rear tyres rolled over his torso. Fatal crush injury to abdomen and pelvis. Body recovered after 2 hours.
Bicycle with two children entered Jorhat Bypass Road near gate 4. Patrol jeep running high speed failed to stop in time. Impact lethal. Both children died at scene. Driver arrested.
Tractor trolley reversing on narrow service track in Digboi field. No banksmen present. Rear wheels hit the electrical panel and struck the operator standing behind. Fatal neck fracture.

Pickup vehicle swerved to avoid goat on Duliajan lease road. Rolled over multiple times into ditch. Occupant ejected and dragged 20m. Severe traumatic brain injury and facial crush. Died in ambulance.

Worker detected H2S spike at 50ppm during pre-entry check in storage tank at Duliajan. Confined space entry permit not yet issued but he opened the manhole manually. PPE was worn but no one else was present to assist.
Contractor team entered Digboi sump without verifying gas test results. Sudden release of vapors caused immediate evacuation. No injuries reported but PTW violation noted.
While closing manhole cover at Naharkatiya, slip on wet surface caused worker to fall into sump. Escaped with minor bruises only. Weather was rainy and visibility low.
Entry into vessel at Moran failed due to high H2S levels detected by portable monitor. Team aborted procedure immediately. No exposure occurred but watchperson was not inside the exclusion zone.
Worker at Lumding Terminal attempted entry into settling tank without LOTO verification. Supervisor stopped activity before any physical contact with internals. Near miss event recorded.
During maintenance at Guwahati Depot, ventilation fan failed while two employees were inside the tank. Emergency exit used within 30 seconds. No respiratory distress reported but alarm triggered.
Contractor at Rangia found manhole open without barricade during night shift. Walked into vicinity but stepped back due to visible gas cloud. Area was isolated immediately after.
At Jorhat Bypass Road, worker slipped on ladder descending from tank hatch. Arrested by harness before hitting the ground. No injury sustained but harness showed signs of strain.
Entry into Digboi filter press vessel was initiated with incomplete gas test. High combustible gas levels detected upon entry. Immediate withdrawal performed. No ignition source present.
Morning shift crew at Duliajan blocked tank entrance with material. Worker reached in to retrieve item but pulled back when vapor cloud formed. Exposure time minimal. Wind direction changed suddenly.

Operator found sleeping in control room at Duliajan, H2S alarm active but no response due to suspected alcohol intake. PTW for nearby maintenance was revoked immediately as high risk of misoperation. No breach occurred but safeguard absent during critical period.

Contractor at Lumding Terminal reported late shift under influence, unable to perform LOTO steps correctly on pump station. Supervisor intervened before energization, preventing potential electrocution or mechanical injury. Zero injury but clear potential for fatal accident identified.

Driver at Rangia depot swerved onto shoulder at high speed due to drowsiness from illicit substance use. Vehicle stopped just inches from a high-pressure transmission line. No impact or injury, but near miss cited for loss of vehicle control near hazard.

Morning shift handover at Digboi delayed 45 mins as valve operator was visibly impaired and confused on SIF status. Manual override was attempted by safety officer, avoiding unintended flow release. No spill or injury, but potential for major environmental and safety incident negated by intervention.

Worker at Jorhat Bypass Road found intoxicated in loading bay, attempting to bypass interlock on truck coupling. Security team stopped action before plug was withdrawn without pressure check. No injury or leak, but high potential for hydraulic crush or spray burn noted.

Overnight security at Guwahati Depot consumed prohibited substance, leading to failure to challenge an unauthorized vehicle approaching storage tanks. Incident discovered at 0600 hrs when vehicle was already in restricted zone. No collision or intrusion, but clear breach of perimeter defense posed serious threat.

Technician at Moran plant slumped at ladder base during maintenance, suspected drug-induced dizziness. Colleague caught him before fall from 3 meters. No injury sustained due to immediate support, but potential for fatality from fall was present.

Fuel bowser driver at Naharkatiya reported brief blackouts while driving to refueling point. Vehicle drifted near wellhead flare pit but stopped short. No fire or injury, but near miss recorded due to loss of consciousness near active ignition source.

Shift charge at Duliajan failed to log critical pressure drop, found with empty alcohol container in locker. Automated alarm triggered shutdown before unsafe operating limits were exceeded. No process upset or injury, but human error due to impairment created near miss condition.

Contractor at Digboi refuelling bay observed using phone and appear disoriented, misjudged distance from live hose. Hose snapped back but did not strike personnel due to quick reaction. No injury, but potential for severe whip lash injury was nearly realized.

Contractor found climbing 8m ladder without harness at Duliajan pump station. Scaffolding plank suddenly slipped from hands dropping tools below. Rescue team stopped work immediately, PTW cancelled. No falls recorded but high energy drop event.

Ladder base shifted on wet deck at Digboi during morning shift. Employee lost footing at 4m height, caught guardrail with both hands. Violent jolt felt, no injury sustained but near miss status confirmed. Safety stand-down initiated.

Roofing sheet slipped from scaffold at Naharkatiya processing area. Sheet struck worker's helmet from 6m height, deflected. Worker staggered but remained stable. Hazardous zone cleared, anchor points inspected.

TBT found loose on platform at Moran, worker attempted to tighten from below without scaffold. Steel component dropped onto foot from 3m. No impact injury but shock reported. PTW violation noted, contractor crew suspended.

Scaffold leg sank into soft soil at Lumding Terminal at night. 5m platform tilted sharply, two men scrambled to roof edge. One fell 2m to catch pipe, massive impact. X-ray negative, muscle strain only. Critical near miss.

Ladder moved while employee ascending at Guwahati Depot. Slip at 1.5m, worker grasped railing too late. Hip impact with concrete wall. No fracture, bruising treated on site. Guardrail non-functional, LOTO bypassed.

Roof maintenance at Rangia, contractor used unsecured ladder. Top rung broke under load at 7m height. Worker suspended in air for 10 mins before rescue. No injury but extreme exposure. SIF trigger event.

Platform edge protection removed for material transport at Jorhat Bypass Road. Worker stepped where guardrail missing, fell 2m. Hit tank surface, rolled. No major trauma, shaken. Unauthorized removal by maintenance crew.

Scaffold collapse at Duliajan flare stack repair. Wind gust 50km/h, temporary structure gave way at 9m. Two contractors fell, caught by lifelines. High energy swing, no collision with ground. Near fatal event, PTW revoked.

Ladder foot lifted by forklift at Digboi storage unit. Worker at 3m lost balance, fell backwards. Hit steel beam on lower back. No fracture, severe pain. Forklift operator not briefed. Major near miss.
Contractor entered 2000 KL storage tank at Digboi without valid PTW, H2S detector alarm triggered, worker exited immediately before exposure. No injury recorded but atmospheric test was missing.
During routine inspection of sump pit at Naharkatiya, loose cover slipped, inspector stepped back avoiding fall into hydrocarbon sludge. PPE was intact, no chemical contact occurred.
Vessel door at Duliajan unit left ajar during shift change, intern tried to enter for cleaning, stopped by supervisor who noted lack of LOTO verification. Potential for energy release existed.
At Lumding Terminal, forklift lifted worker near tank manhole, hook snagged on clothing but released, worker unharmed. High risk of strangulation if snag had held.
Heavy rain in Jorhat Bypass Road area caused slip on tank access ladder, employee fell back onto platform edge, caught guardrail. No fracture, near miss confined to loss of balance.
Moran site saw unauthorized entry into degasser manhole by third-party vendor, sensor indicated high H2S, vendor reversed before crossing threshold. Gas level was critical.
Guwahati Depot truck fire extinguisher blocked tank entry point, emergency drill revealed restricted egress route. No one trapped, but escape path was compromised.
At Rangia, steam leak near vessel inspection plate announced during entry prep, worker removed face shield to adjust, steam jet released inches from eyes. No injury, but high energy hazard active.
Digboi storage area, contractor ladder leaned against tank inlet, foot slipped, ladder shifted but did not collapse. Worker held onto tank structure, potential for fall into tank existed.
Naharkatiya polymerization vessel top, safety chain broke during purging, worker on top lacked tie-off, momentary suspension before rescue. No injury, but fall distance was 15m.

While removing blind bolts on 6" water line, worker got high pressure spray to forearm from loose gasket. Bleeding controlled with pressure bandage, sent to camp infirmary. PTW had blind removal in scope but isolation verification was incomplete.

Contractor pinched finger between flange faces while tightening bolts on N2 line. Skin was broken and swelled up. First aid applied, treated as minor laceration requiring stitches. Shift 2 evening work.

During blind swap on fuel gas header, live line was not fully depressurized. Gas escaping through gasket caused worker to slip and scrape hand on sharp pipe edge. Cut required medical attention but no permanent damage. H2S monitor alarm went off briefly.
Technician cut palm on jagged metal edge while cutting old flange bolts for removal. Deep cut bled heavily. CPT team assisted with dressing. Incident logged as recordable due to depth of wound.

When opening inspection blind on heavy duty separator line, high velocity fluid jet struck worker in the shoulder. Caused severe bruising and temporary loss of feeling. Medical officer prescribed rest and painkillers. No fracture found on X-ray.

Loading arm gasket failed during connection at bowser bay. Oil spray hit operator's face and neck, causing chemical irritation and small burn. Washed out with eye wash station and treated with burn cream. Product was light crude but hot.

Worker trapped wrist in valve guard while isolating line for maintenance. Swelling and pain indicated possible ligament strain. Requested ambulance for further check. No damage to skin but restricted movement for 3 days.

During blind removal on steam line, superheated steam escaped from live side due to misaligned blind. Worker got burn on back of hand. Treated for second degree burn. Contractor crew did not follow LOTO procedure properly for steam out.

Hand got caught in flange gap while inserting new gasket on high pressure line. Bruising and abrasion sustained. Did not require hospitalization but medical certificate issued. Work stopped after incident for safety briefing.
While cutting bolts on corroded flange, sharp metal fragment flew off and grazed temple. Small cut caused bleeding. Cleaned and bandaged at field clinic. Worker returned to desk duties next day.
Contractor team opened manhole at Lift Station 3 without valid PTW. Gas detector reading 15% LEL but work stopped before entry. No injury, near miss only.
Expired permit found in use for hot work near flare header during night shift. Fire watch absent. H2S alarm triggered, crew withdrew immediately. No damage or injury.
Employee performed lathing on pipeline without LOTO verification. Pressure gauge showed 2 bar residual. Valve tagged but not isolated completely. Near miss as no release occurred.
Forged signature on PTW for scaffolding erection found during audit. Work halted. Suspect compromised for safety violation. No structural failure, near miss recorded.
Gas test report missing for confined space entry at clarifier. Supervisor allowed entry without first air check. Worker stepped out upon realizing error. No exposure, near miss.
Drilling rig crew used general permit for specific wellhead operation. PTW not specific to high-risk activity. Sudden pressure spike contained by BOP. No injury or spill, near miss.
Contractor vehicle entered restricted zone without valid entry permit. Proximity to running pump caused minor vibration alarm. Driver stopped truck. No collision, near miss.
Work order referenced closed PTW number. Workers started electrical isolation without new permit. Circuit was live but no contact made. HSE team intervened. Near miss.
Rain delayed gas testing for tank cleaning. Crew proceeded with cleaning using old 4am readings. H2S detector beeped at 10ppm. Exit protocol followed. No symptom, near miss.
SIF inhibit used without approved deviation or extended PTW. Isolation valve failed to close fully. Leak detected by visual check. System shut down safely. Near miss.
Operator under influence found sleeping on pump platform at Duliajan, woke up confused and developed severe nausea requiring ambulance transfer to hospital.
Contractor at Digboi failed H2S breathing apparatus fit test due to alcohol consumption, showed signs of intoxication and required medical attention for dizziness.
Driver at Naharkatiya reported positive drug test after minor collision with bollards, sustained minor lacerations on hand treated by site medic.
Technician at Moran found slumped over control panel during night shift, exhibited slurred speech indicative of alcohol impairment, taken for medical evaluation.
Employee at Lumding Terminal caught consuming alcohol near loading arm, tried to resist PTW audit leading to fall and sprained ankle needing splinting.
Guwahati Depot loader reported fatigue and disorientation during shift, urine sample positive for narcotics, required medical supervision and removal from duty.
Rangia refinery operator found unresponsive in control room, initial assessment suggested drug-induced sedation, woken with difficulty and treated for hypotension.
Contractor at Jorhot Bypass Road observed handling valves while visibly impaired by alcohol, slip resulted in head bump and severe headache requiring hospital checkup.
Morning shift supervisor at Duliajan failed pre-start sobriety test, showed signs of hangover and disorientation, taken to clinic for monitoring of blood pressure.
Naharkatiya maintenance worker found hiding behind tank farm with empty beer cans, developed acute alcohol withdrawal symptoms requiring immediate medical intervention.
Contractor welding on 6in pipeline at Digboi without hot work PTW. Sparks hit nearby leaking valve, small fire started, hand burn to worker requiring dressing.

Grinding spark ignition of hydrocarbon vapour near storage tank at Duliajan. No ignition but pressure wave pushed worker back. Worker sprained ankle, treated on site and referred to hospital for X-ray.

At Naharkatiya, employee using angle grinder near flange. Shield missing, flying debris struck eye. Immediate first aid failed, employee transported to Guwahati hospital for corneal abrasion treatment.

Hot work on corroded pipe at Moran. Gas detector showed H2S spike during cutting. Worker exposed, developed nausea. Medical evaluation required, no fracture but recorded as occupational illness with treatment.

Tank farm at Lumding Terminal. Welding on gauge hatch. Spatter melted through protective coating, caused second degree burn on contractor forearm. Causative agent was direct flame contact, treated in infirmary.
Guwahati Depot night shift. Grinding near diesel pump. Slip on oil spill while moving grinder, worker fell and fractured wrist. Ambulance dispatched, hospitalised for cast application.

At Rangia, cutting operation on low point drain. No LOTO verified. Unexpected flow of viscous oil spray contacted hot cutting torch, causing flash fire. Worker suffered thermal burn to face, required emergency medical intervention.

Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline repair. Contractor welding without adequate ventilation. Fumes caused acute respiratory distress. Worker vomited, given oxygen, transported to nearest clinic for observation and medication.
Digboi unit 4. Grinding near open drum. Debris ejected, hit helmet and shoulder. Worker complained of deep laceration to deltoid muscle. Suturing required at site medical centre.
Duliajan terminal. Hot work on flange bolt. Hydraulic leak under pressure caused scalding injury to leg. Skin peeled, treated with sterile dressings, recorded as severity 2 injury.
While cutting flange bolts on line 301, residual pressure caused steam jet injury to hand. Employee received first aid and referred to site hospital for treatment.
Contractor failed to isolate hydraulic accumulator before removing cover. Residual pressure ejected pin causing laceration to forearm. Medical attention required on site.
During maintenance of compressor, trapped spring energy released upon disassembly. Employee sustained abrasions to leg from falling valve plate. Treated at clinic.
Unisolated static electricity discharge from drum during pumping operation. Spark caused minor burn to operator's palm. No further injury reported.
PTW issued without verifying zero energy state on pump. Mechanical seal blowout sprayed hot lube oil on technician. Heat burn treatment at site medical center.
Residual gas pressure in pipeline section caused valve handle to spin violently. Employee struck face by handle, nosebleed and soft tissue injury. Ambulance called for assessment.

LOTO tag removed prematurely by another crew while capacitor bank de-energizing. Stored charge caused electric shock to worker, muscle cramps and dizziness. Admitted to local hospital for observation.
High-pressure water pipe burst during flushing due to unisolated source. Jet impact caused deep cut on thigh of contractor. Surgical stitching performed at nearby hospital.
Spring-loaded safety valve lifted unexpectedly during test, scalding steam contacted face. Minor blistering and eye irritation reported. Medical check-up completed on site.
Residual pressure in small bore line released abrasive particles upon opening. Worker suffered corneal scratch in one eye. Treated with eye drops and monitored.

Grinding sparks ignited flash vapour at Digboi tank farm, worker on night shift got 2nd degree burns on forearms treated at local clinic. Gas detector alarm triggered late due to faulty sensor calibration.

Welding on pig launcher at Duliajan without proper LOTO, pressure leak caused face shield to blow off hitting eye causing corneal abrasion. PTW was valid but isolation points were not tagged correctly.
Cutting flange near active line at Rangia, sudden jet fire singed eyebrows and back of neck. Fire extinguisher deployed by stand-by team but worker reported stinging pain requiring ointment.

Employee at Lumding Terminal slipped on oil spill near hot work zone, fell on knee while holding welding lead, laceration stitched with minimal bleeding. No HSE supervision present during shift change.
Grinding sparks landed in open drain at Guwahati Depot, causing minor steam burn on hand of nearby helper. Ventilation was poor inside the shed and no fire watch was assigned.
Contractor at Naharkatiya using angle grinder on pipeline support, shield missing, flying metal chunk hit temple causing deep cut needing 4 sutures. Toolbox talk not recorded for the day.
Welding insulation joint at Moran field, gas leak from faulty regulator caused dizziness and chemical irritation to eyes. First aid kit applied but referred to field clinic for eye wash.

Hot work permit exceeded time limit at Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline, smoke from drying paint ignited near grinding area, worker inhaled fumes and had mild respiratory distress. Ambient temperature was high at 14:00 hrs.

Sparks from oxy-acetylene cutter at Digboi refinery area landed on spilled hydraulic oil, small flash back grazed cheek of operator. Emergency shower available but not used immediately due to hesitation.
Electrode welding on vessel bottom at Duliajan, arc flash blinded left eye temporarily causing headache and sensitivity. No full face shield worn, only safety glasses, violating PPE requirements.
Grinding on flange at pump station, PTW valid but no gas detection before start. Sudden hiss of gas, operator stopped work immediately. Near miss, no injury.
Welding near idle pipeline, H2S detector beeping intermittently. Crew held position for clearance, no ignition occurred. Close call.
Cutting tank nozzle, sparks flew into drainage ditch. No hydrocarbon smell detected but fire risk high. Work halted, area swept.
Hot work permit issued for vessel inspection. Contractor found residual sludge during pre-work scan. Job halted, HSE notified. Potential explosion averted.
Grinding on railing, sparks landed on nearby oil seal. No ignition but operator shocked. LOTO verified again. Near miss reported.
Welding on pipeline support brick in heat. Fumes choked worker, he stepped back. No injury but visibility poor. SIF could have resulted if fumes inhaled longer.
Cutting valve body, unexpected pressure relief valve opened. No discharge of liquid but steam jet close to face. Immediate evacuation of zone.
Welding on storage tank shell, ground clamp loose. Arc struck nearby pipe. No burn or fire but damaged coating. Corrective action taken.
hot work job at Lumding Terminal: unexpected sparks near open hydrocarbon line noticed by the crew; immediate stand-down, no injuries reported.
hot work job at Naharkatiya: unexpected sparks near open hydrocarbon line noticed by the crew; immediate stand-down, no injuries reported.

Contractor suffered a chemical burn to the forearm while entering the rusted sump at Digboi; PTW was valid but H2S detector had flat battery. Worker rushed to hospital for debridement, classified as recordable.

During night shift cleanout at Lumding Terminal, an employee slipped on oily sludge inside the tank and fractured a finger on the manhole rim. Supervisor applied first aid but worker insist on X-ray at local clinic.
At Naharkatiya, a labourer got a severe laceration from a corroded steel flange edge while crawling into the vessel. Bleeding stopped with pressure bandage but required stitches at camp infirmary.

Entry into sump at Moran delayed due to low oxygen alert; once cleared, contractor tripped over a flexible hose and sprained ankle. Medical report confirms ligament strain, treated with ice and elevation.
Employee cut palm on a sharp bolt head inside the dead storage tank at Duliajan. Wound was cauterised and dressed on-site; worker returned to light duties next day after assessment.
During inspection of manhole at Guwahati Depot, a wrench slipped and struck a worker's wrist causing a small open wound. Tetanus shot administered, no hospitalisation needed but logged as recordable.

Heat stress induced dizziness forced a worker to bail out of the hot oil tank at Rangia. Blood pressure checked, given oral rehydration; no fracture or injury but treated as recordable due to on-site medical intervention.
Contractor stepped on a protruding nail inside the empty sump at Jorhat Bypass Road, causing a puncture wound to the sole. Wound irrigated and bandaged; worker off work for two days pending healing.
While removing a blind flange at Naharkatiya, a sharp edge grazed the worker's calf. Minor hydrocarbon splash also noted. Received antibiotic prophylaxis and dressing change at medical bay.
Worker at Digboi hit his head against the internal ladder rung while exiting the tank, resulting in a scalp laceration. No loss of consciousness, but required suturing at nearby hospital.

PTW valid but LOTO not applied on crane hook block during maintenance at dusk. 2 ton load shifted due to wind gust, swinging directly over lead scaffolder who was welding. H2S alarm triggered nearby but no gas release. Worker cleared area immediately, no injury but potential for crushing.

Forklift operator at Lumding Terminal lifted 500kg pump unit without spotter. Chain failed mid-lift, unit dropped from 2m height onto empty yard. Debris scattered 10m. If operator had been in drop zone, fatal impact likely. Site shut down for inspection.

Contractor crew installing cable tray at Naharkatiya. Anchor bolt sheared off during tensioning, 15kg bracket fell from 12m. Missed lead man by 1 meter, struck hard hat on ground. Witness saw bolt spinning down. No injury but high-energy object release near personnel.

Crane luffing up at Duliajan site, counterweight bracket loosened. During lift of 8ft pipe, bracket detached and fell onto mud mat. Operator aware of shifting load, stopped operation. If bracket had hit head or torso, fatal. No one hurt but safeguard failure evident.

Scaffold platform at Moran P&G shook violently during material hoist. TBT not tightened on base supports before lift. Platform tilted 15 degrees, workers on top held on. 200kg load suspended 3m above. No fall occurred but imminent risk of collapse onto workers below.

Guwahati Depot shift change overlap, crane hook left suspended with 100kg valve assembly. Wind picked up, load rotated and struck adjacent tanker truck roof. Truck driver heard bang, checked roof. If worker had walked under, fatal crush injury possible. No injuries reported.

Rangia refinery yard, mobile crane outrigger sank into soft soil during lift. Boom dipped, 300kg skid package lowered rapidly but controlled. Operator aborted lift. If outrigger fully failed, boom could have struck ground crew. No one in exclusion zone but boundary not maintained.

Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline trench, scaffolding tower leaned over edge. Wind gust during monsoon season caused tower to shift 30cm. Worker on level 2 clutching guardrail. Load of pipes stored on ground level below tower. If tower fell, pipes would have collapsed onto workers. No injury but critical instability.

Digboi station, temporary derrick used for lifting condenser. Rope slipped on winch drum, 1.5 ton load dropped 4m. Dust cloud obscured view. Two mechanics ran back 5m. If they had been standing under load, fatal. No immediate injury but near miss with high energy release.

Naharkatiya compressor unit, spare cylinder hoisted without rigger present. Slings snapped, cylinder hit concrete skid and rolled. Struck safety line near electrical panel. Operator near panel startled. If line had energized, electrocution and crush risk. No injury but multi-hazard scenario.
Scaffold planking slipped during shift change at 0600 hrs, contractor fell 2 meters to lower deck, caught by safety harness, no injury reported, PTW valid, wind strong.
Ladder slipped on wet platform surface, operator slid down 3 meters, feet braked by railing, no slip, H2S alarm silent, rain intensity moderate.
Roof access hatch missing cover, maintenance crew stepped into opening, caught by trolley wire, near fall hazard, no injury, housekeeping lapse found.
Temporary scaffold leg buckled under load, platform tilted 45 degrees, worker inside LOTO zone, no fall due to tight space, no injury, PTW renewed yesterday.
Lumding terminal truck loading rack, driver leaned over railing to check gauge, lost balance, grabbed pipe, no injury, no warning sign present.
Contractor used defective step ladder, rung broke, 1.5 meter drop to ground, broken ankle suspected but no first aid required, left site immediately.
Night shift, lighting poor on Rangia pipeline corridor, worker tripped on uneven ground near valve, fell 1 meter, no impact, no injury, visibility issue noted.
Jorhat Bypass road junction, worker on traffic island ladder, vehicle struck base, ladder shifted, worker held on, no fall, no injury, escort absent.
Duliajan flare stack maintenance, tool dropped from 10 meters, hit platform edge, no one below, near miss for lower crew, tool contained, no injury.
Naharkatiya tank roof inspection, guardrail gate left open, inspector stepped back, almost fell, caught by supervisor, no injury, PTW expired, work stopped.
Contractor found working on pump seal without valid PTW, gas test paper expired 2 hrs prior. Spilled lubricant caused slip, cut on forearm required sutures.
Expired hot work permit used for welding on pipeline. Minor flash burn on hand, treated by site medic. No fire escalation.
Skipped gas testing before entering confined space in digester tank. Worker felt dizzy, removed by lift line. Treated for mild headache and nausea.
Forged LOTO tag discovered during audit. Worker was unscrewing valve when noticed. Small abrasion on finger from tool, cleaned and bandaged.
PTW lapsed during shift change, work continued for 20 mins. Loose bolt fell, grazed ankle of supervisor. Required dressing and tetanus booster.
Missing permit for scaffolding erection at height. Slight twist of ankle on uneven ground. X-ray clear but treated with ice and compression.
Gas test result not recorded in permit log. H2S alarm chirped, worker stepped back from drum. Minor chemical irritation to eyes, rinsed with water.
Working without PTW on electrical panel. Arc flash caused minor burn on forearm. Treated with burn cream and observation. No cardiac issues.
Expired permit for confined space entry in separator. Worker tripped on ladder, bruised hip and shoulder. Assessed in ambulance, no fracture.
No gas test performed before hot work near flare tip. Spark ignited minor leak, worker pulled away. Small singe burn on sleeve, minor pain.

Contractor trolley driver reversing on lease road at Naharkatiya near pump station, failed to spot pipeline marker, struck worker's shin with tire. Worker reported severe pain later, sent to hospital for X-ray, no fracture but deep bruising and swelling. PTW active but spotter was absent during initial backing maneuver.

Employee in 4x4 driving fast on Digboi lease road during monsoon downpour, vehicle lost traction and clipped a watchman who was standing by fence. Watchman fell, injured ankle, required immediate medical attention. Speed was high despite wet surface warnings, no LOTO involved as vehicle was in motion.

TBT truck attempting reversal on narrow track at Duliajan production unit, rammed into a low hanging branch which fell on operator's head. Operator sustained scalp laceration requiring suturing. Reversing alarm was working but visibility was poor due to late evening shift and rain.

Hydrant crew vehicle at Rangia depot moving over speed bump too fast, a tool bag shifted and struck the driver's arm. Driver complained of wrist pain, sent to clinic, diagnosed with soft tissue injury. Vehicle was owned by contractor, driver was fatigued after 14-hour shift.

Cow wandered onto Jorhat Bypass road near site entry, patrol jeep braked hard, passenger slumped forward hitting dashboard. Passenger required medical check for chest pain, no fracture but significant bruising. No PTW needed for road patrol, but speed limit was exceeded.

Mud truck driver at Moran field reversing near rig pad, tire crushed section of air hose, sudden recoil hit worker's leg. Worker suffered crush injury to lower leg, treated on-site and monitored. Driver was looking at phone while reversing, SIF not triggered but potential was high.

Employee in company car overspeeding on Lumding Terminal access road, lost control on oil spill, car skidded into bollard. Driver sustained minor head bump and neck strain, hospitalized for observation. Guard was present but did not stop the vehicle earlier.

Contractor dumper truck at Guwahati Depot driving on employee walkway during night shift, struck a stumbling employee. Employee fell, fractured elbow, immediate ambulance called. Driver was fatigued, PTW for material movement expired but vehicle still on site.

Small utility vehicle at Duliajan reversing into laydown area, struck a stack of pipe sections. One pipe rolled off, hitting maintenance worker in the calf. Worker required medical treatment for laceration and abrasions. Worker was not wearing safety boots compliant with ISO standards.

Jeep driver at Digboi main gate reversing without spotter, hit the ankle of a security guard who was directing traffic. Guard injured ankle badly, transported to hospital. Driver was a permanent employee, visibility was low due to smoke from nearby generator.
Worker felt sudden dizziness and mild headache after entering sump without fresh air supply, exited voluntarily and received medical observation at site clinic.
Contractor cut his forearm on sharp edge of manhole cover while descending into tank, wound cleaned and bandaged by first aid team but required professional suturing at hospital.
Employee slipped on wet surface inside empty storage tank and fractured left wrist during climb down ladder, PTW was valid but grounding strip not installed properly.
Gas detector alarm triggered inside vessel during entry inspection, one worker experienced mild chest pain and nausea, taken to local hospital for checkup and discharged after 4 hours.
Bystander near manhole sustained minor laceration on hand when worker dropped entry inspection tool, injury treated with first aid only but logged as recordable due to broken skin depth.
Worker tripped over unsecured hose inside tank and sprained ankle, required ice pack and immobilization, PTW held but tagging on blind flange was incomplete.
Contractor inhaling residual vapors inside sump leading to eye irritation and vomiting, removed from confined space immediately and treated at field medical unit.
Employee hit head on low-hanging pipe inside tank during vigorous cleaning, sustained concussion and minor scalp abrasion, transported to city hospital for MRI and observation.
Worker suffered thermal burn on face from leaking steam trap near tank entry point, skin blistered and treated with burn cream, required follow-up at specialist clinic.
Misjudged ladder rung inside vessel causing knee injury and torn ligament, worker assisted out of tank and ambulatory but required surgical consultation for possible repair.
During pipe run at Digboi, load swing due to high wind caused near miss with derrick leg, tag line held but no contact.
Naharkatiya: Sling failed on flyaway load at dusk, debris landed 2 meters from worker, no injury reported, PTW valid.
Crane at Lumding Terminal lifted tank valve without tag line, load rotated unexpectedly near walkway, worker stepped back just in time.
Guwahati Depot: Shackle pin slippage during hose loading, pin dropped near truck driver, no hit, vehicle stopped safely.
Rangia: Overturned wellhead tong during lift, load dropped 3 ft from trestle, no one in suspended load zone, near miss.
Duliajan: Wire rope parting on 5-ton load, load swung into wind direction away from crew, no contact, rig up delayed.
Jorhat Bypass Road: Truck crane operator failed to use tag line on tank assembly, load snagged on tree branch, no collision, near miss.
Moran: Hydraulic hose burst on crane arm, fluid jet near operator face, no injury, system isolated immediately, near miss.
Digboi: Crane outrigger settlement on soft ground, load dipped 1 meter, worker below moved clear, no strike, near miss.
Naharkatiya: Rigging material worn, shackle twisted under load, load drifted towards flare stack, no fire, no injury, near miss.
Contractor ladder shifted while cutting pipe above 4m, worker slipped and landed on scaffolding planks, sustained ankle sprain requiring medical attention.
Employee removed lifeline lanyard to tie boot, lost balance on walkway during PTW check, caught by safety net but injured wrist.
Scaffold board snapped under foot during rain at night, worker fell 3m onto pipe rack, dislocated shoulder needing reduction at hospital.
Ladder not secured to structure, worker climbed without harness, lost grip on rung and rolled off, bruised ribs and minor lacerations.
Worker slipped on wet roof while inspecting flashlights, fell 2.5m onto gravel, fractured coccyx requiring medical treatment.
Employee kicked loose bolt while standing on platform edge, lost footing, fell 1.5m onto concrete, head contusion and neck strain.
Contractor scaffold missing toe boards, worker stepped on loose plank, slid off edge, injured foot and lower back from impact.
Worker climbed on outside of scaffold frame without authorization, slipped on muddy ground below, fractured fibula after fall.
Ladder placed on uneven ground near H2S area, worker leaned to tighten valve, ladder tilted, fell 2m, sustained knee ligament damage.
Employee failed to tie off to anchor point while cleaning platform, slipped on oil spill, fell 3m, severe bruising to hip and back.
Contractor entered 80ft flare stack without valid PTW, oxygen level not confirmed. Slipped on rung, lacerated forearm, treated at site clinic.
Expired H2S PTW used for blowdown line replacement. Sudden release caught worker in face, chemical burn to eyes and hands. Evacuated to hospital.
Forged PTW found during audit for hot work near gas separator. Worker cut by falling pipe while unpermitted, minor fracture to wrist. X-ray confirmed.
No gas test done before entering pump house. Worker ignited atmosphere with grinder, flash fire singed eyebrows and face. First aid insufficient, medic took over.
PTW expired during night shift at loading bay. Pump failed, spilled fuel. Worker slipped, twisted ankle severely. Required splint and transport.
Hot work PTW missing scope for confined space. Worker fell 10ft, landed on feet. Sprained ankle, pain unmanageable with first aid. Doctor advised rest.
LOTO not applied per PTW, valve moved unexpectedly. Hose whipped, struck shoulder, bruised ribs. Pain limited movement, sent for checkup.
Verbal authorization instead of written PTW for line break. Steam leak flashed, scalded face and neck. Redness and blistering, beyond first aid scope.
PTW signed but gas test results blank. H2S detector beeped, worker rushed out, twisted knee on exit. Swollen joint, unable to bear weight. Hospital visit.
Contractor bypassed permit requirement for electrical work. Arc flash occurred, minor burns to forearms. Skin peeled, infection risk high. Medical treatment started.
Welding on 6" line without proper PTW, flash fire engulfed operator, gas cloud dispersed before explosion. Operator escaped with minor burns but high energy release noted.
Cutting on storage tank roof, grinder slipped into tank. Tank was not fully degassed and purged. Spark ignited vapours. Worker fell but caught on edge. Potential fatality if tank blew.
Grinding near open hydrocarbon spill. Flame jet reached 3 meters towards onlookers. No LOTO on adjacent line. Incident stopped when valve manually closed. No injury but high risk of fireball.
Welding on active pipeline, H2S alarm triggered. Worker exposed to high concentration. Unplanned release could have caused asphyxiation or poisoning. Evacuation delayed due to communication gap.

Oxy-acetylene cutting on thin gauge vessel. Vessel buckled and released pressurised fluid. Jet fire directed at platform edge. Worker startled, no burn but high likelihood of engulfment if longer duration.

Grinding sparks ignited flammable atmosphere inside tank. Flash fire pushed worker against wall. Worker survived due to PPE but potential for severe thermal injury was imminent. Ventilation inadequate.

Hot work on pump casing, seal failed. Hydrocarbon spray contacted arc. Immediate ignition. Blasting wave pushed worker over. No fracture recorded but force sufficient to cause amputation or crush injury.
Welding on pipeline support, H2S detection alarm not functional. Worker stood downwind of leak. Potential for rapid unconsciousness and death. Area evacuated only after visual confirmation of leak.
Cutting on tank bottom, water hammer effect caused structural failure. Tank collapsed partially. Worker was 2 meters away. Debris shower and potential crush injury avoided only by chance.
Grinding on flare header, hot work permit expired. Flash fire at nozzle. Worker in immediate vicinity. High energy flame front could have caused fatal burns. SIF not engaged due to valve stuck.
While lifting the air cooler bundle, the load swung towards the rigging crew due to strong crosswind, stopping just inches from the rigger's face.
A single leg of the chain sling snapped during the lift of a pump skid, causing the load to drop 2 meters onto empty ground; no personnel were in the exclusion zone.
The crane operator failed to use tag line for a steel pipe load, resulting in uncontrolled rotation that missed the standby worker by a marginal distance.
During night shift operations, a shackle pin dislodged from the hook block, and the load of 500kg valves fell onto the hardstand; near miss as area was cordoned off.
Load suspended over the truck bed shifted suddenly, nearly pinning the tailgate operator against the vehicle structure before being secured.
Overlooked LOTO procedure resulted in unexpected movement of the conveyor belt while a forklift was lifting a spare part, causing the operator to jump back just in time.
The spreader bar hung horizontally during a vertical lift, causing the load to wobble dangerously, but it was stopped before contacting the pipeline rack.
A loose crate on top of a pallet shifted during transport, nearly hitting the driver's cab during a sharp turn on the access road.
Crane boom descended unexpectedly while lowering a transformer, dropping it onto the transformer pad inches from the electrician's feet.
Improper rigging angle caused the sling to slip off the drum, resulting in a free fall of 3 meters onto empty soil; PTW was valid but inspection was rushed.
Contractor broke isolation on accumulator without verifying zero energy, H2S jet hit face shield but no laceration due to PPE. SIF activated but physical barrier absent initially.
Residual pressure in 150m pipeline released upon valve opening during LOTO bypass. Worker stood downwind, high velocity spray izzu but no contact. Pressure gauge was faulty.
Accumulator pre-charge bleed failed, device kicked out when removed from skid. 200psi release, worker in 3m radius, no injury due to distance. No PTW for pressure relief.
Spring energy in control valve actuator released unexpectedly during maintenance. Flange cover flew 5m, missed operator's head by inches. No PTW, unisolated equipment.
Unisolated steam line discharged superheated vapor when connection loosened. Worker exposed to 350C jet, no burns due to quick retreat and leathers. Near miss on face.

Pipeline pig trap opened with residual hydraulic pressure. Hydraulic fluid jet at high pressure, worker stood directly in line. No injection injury as skin intact, but potential for amputation if plate severed.

Expander compressor unisolated, rotating assembly spun down slowly but stored rotational energy remained. Tool contact caused kickback, tool struck shoulder area narrowly avoided. No mechanical guard removed.
Gas spring in manway cover released upon disengagement. High velocity upward force, cover bounced 2m, worker below missed by 1 foot. No isolation verification done.
High pressure nitrogen bleed line unisolated, valve stuck in open. On removal of filter, 400bar jet impinged on gloves. No puncture, but potential for tissue damage was extreme. No PTW.

Cracked flange gasket under 200bar hydrostatic test pressure. Sudden leak created sonic boom and water hammer force. Worker in arc of projection, no injury but potential for eardrum rupture or blast trauma was real.

Contractor welding on 6-inch carbon steel line at Duliajan gas plant during afternoon shift, gas detector failed to alarm near open hydrocarbon leak, worker suffered level 3 burn to face and neck, transported casualty to GHSP for treatment.

Employee grinding flange on inactive tank d-101 at Digboi, secondary containment breach released flammable vapors, no hot work permit valid, explosion potential high but no ignition source present, near miss recorded after supervisor intervened.

Fire during oxy-fuel cutting of pipe spur at Naharkatiya well pad, wind shift blew flame towards adjacent skid, PPE protected worker but handguard shattered, severe laceration to thumb requiring hospital admission, hand function compromised.

Hot work on top of crude storage tank at Moran tank farm, LOTO tag removed unauthorized, residual pressure caused jet fire near welder, no casualties but high energy release threatened life, PSIF classification due to lack of water curtain activation.

Sparks from angle grinder landed on oily rag near pump seal at Lumding Terminal, immediate flash fire engulfed area, worker donned AFR breathing apparatus and escaped with smoke inhalation, required oxygen therapy for 24 hours, recordable injury.

During maintenance of vapor recovery unit at Guwahati Depot, confined space entry without proper gas monitoring, sudden release of H2S caused two workers to collapse, rescue team extracted them but one succumbed to asphyxiation despite CPR, fatal incident.

Welding on underground pipeline excavation at Rangia field, shoring collapsed due to heavy machinery vibration, worker pinned under steel casing, hip fracture sustained, evacuated by air ambulance, serious injury confirmed.

Grinding operation on structural steel near high pressure header at Jorhat Bypass Road compressor station, gas ball valve failed while open, uncontrolled release created flammable cloud, workers evacuated before ignition, no injuries, near miss with high consequence potential.

Hot work permit expired before completion of weld on steam line at Duliajan, contractor continued operation, steam blowout occurred striking supervisor, second degree burns to upper body, admitted to district hospital, recordable case.

Cutting of old pipeline segment at Digboi, residual crude ignited causing flash fire, worker trapped in trench, sustained thermal burns to 60% body surface area, death occurred at scene despite emergency response, major fatality.
Welding spark near 6 inch line caused rapid H2S bleed into pit. Wind shifted suddenly, detector alarm tripped before concentration reached LEL. No one inhaled due to immediate evacuation order.
Grinding off old coupling on storage tank nozzle created heavy dust. Sudden wind gust blew debris into filter housing, causing clog. No fire or ignition occurred.

During cutting of support bracket under platform, hot slag fell into open manway. Smoke filled space briefly. Worker gasp but exited air-free environment without using SCBA. Confined space entry stopped.
Plasma cutter ignited vapor pocket near maintenance hatch. Flash fire visible for 2 seconds only. Extinguisher applied immediately. No burns reported, but potential for severe flash burn was high.
Welding on empty pipeline section released trapped hydrocarbons. Strong odor detected 50m away. Work stopped, area gas tested negative after ventilation. No ignition source active at time of release.
Cutting wheel broke during operation, fragment flew towards worker's face. Hard hat visor deflected shard. Worker flinched back, no contact with skin. Tool locked out immediately.

Grinding near diesel tank dike produced continuous sparks. Nearby flammable liquid spill not cleaned up. Fire watch noticed glowing char on rag but no flame propagation. Risk assessed as high potential.
Hot work permit expired while arc welding continued. Contractor unaware of time lapse. Supervisor noticed and halted job. No injury, but violation of PTW procedure noted.

Angle grinder sparked near propane cylinder stored improperly. Cylinder valve open during work. Worker noticed leak sound, closed valve and moved cylinder. No ignition, but close proximity to open flame risk identified.

Torch cutting on corroded pipe section caused unexpected rupture. High pressure gas jet visible. Valve isolated within 10 seconds. No personnel in direct path, but forceful release indicated potential for jet fire.
Worker slipped on slick mud while prying open a flange on the 4-inch letdown line during rain. He fell and twisted his ankle, requiring splinting and transport to nearest clinic.
Contractor used oversized spanner on tight blind bolt, causing it to snap. Worker received a laceration on hand from flying bolt head, treated at site HMO.
H2S alarm triggered when gasket failed on inspection side during blind removal. Worker inhaled low level H2S, felt giddiness, given oxygen and case medically recorded.
While unbolting a flange on stale line, last two bolts released suddenly. Worker pushed back by jet stream, minor bruising on chest, first aid upgraded to recordable.
Valve packed with wax, lever broken off during isolation. Contractor struck on head by falling lever, minor scalp abrasion, stitched at site.
Unplanned weeping from flange O-ring caused worker to lose footing on ladder. Fall from 4ft height resulted in wrist strain, X-ray done, no fracture.
Blind tightened against active line due to PTW error. High velocity water jet cut through glove, deep gash on forearm, sutures at district hospital.
Worker walked into pressurised spray of condensate when upstream valve failed to close. Scalding on face and chest, treated for second degree burn, case recordable.
Spectator outside exclusion zone caught in backflow of gas from open flange. Dizziness reported, sent for observation, no fracture but absconced work for 2 days.
Heavy wrench landed on foot of employee blowing out line. Bruised metatarsals, pain restricting movement, medically examined and restricted from duty.

PTW issued for valve maintenance but upstream pressure not bled off. Erection crew failed LOTO check, pipeline residual pressure released causing Ghee to suffer laceration to forearm. First aid applied on site, later transferred to hospital for stitching. Contractor worker from Digboi shift.
