While replacing motor coupling, Fitter noticed spring energy stored in actuator. No LOTO tag applied, actuator snapped releasing force. Employee struck in shoulder, X-ray confirmed minor fracture. Treatment received at local clinic. Duliajan refinery maintenance team.

Scaffolding removal in progress, hoist brake released accidentally. Stored potential energy in winch cable snapped. Worker caught hand in roller guard, crushed fingers. Medical aid given immediately. Heavy rain during operation at Moran pumping station.

Gas line isolation for welding, blind flange removed without confirming upstream valve closed. Residual H2S gas released causing respiratory distress. Worker admitted for oxygen therapy and observation. Employee from Guwahati Depot warehouse team.

During pressure test preparation, isolation valve not fully closed. Residual pressure in header line caused fitting to pop out. Contractor worker hit in thigh by flying debris. Wound required suturing and antibiotic. Night shift at Naharkatiya field.

Pneumatic system maintenance, air supply not isolated. Accumulated pressure in air header released suddenly. Tool kicked back, striking operator in chest. Bruising and rib strain diagnosed. Employee from Rangia processing unit.

Tank cleaning operation, static discharge generated during entry. Residual vapour explosion potential isolated but minor shock injury to hand. Medical treatment provided for nerve damage. Contractor from Lumding Terminal storage area.

Elevator machine maintenance, counterweight brake released. Stored kinetic energy in system not dissipated. Worker hand trapped between guide rails, severe abrasion. Hospital visit required for wound cleaning. Jorhat Bypass Road loading bay.

High pressure hose replacement, fluid spray from unisolated fitting. Hydraulic oil jet caused laceration to palm. First aid failed to stop bleeding, emergency transport to hospital. Employee from Digboi production wing.

Valve stem repair, downstream pressure not vented. Residual energy in pipe section forced plug out. Worker face scratched by metal fragments, eye injury suspected. Ophthalmologist consult arranged. Contractor from Duliajan gas plant.

During PTW verification at Digboi, contractor found blind flange loose on 6 inch line. Slight H2S whiff detected, no exposure as area was evacuated immediately. No injury, potential for significant release.
While isolating pump at Naharkatiya, gasket blew out on flange connection. Steam jet sprayed nearby, but worker was wearing full PPE and stepped back. No skin burn or injury reported, pure near miss.

Morning shift at Lumding Terminal, valve stem sheared off during maintenance. High pressure gas hissed but no one was standing in the direct path due to proper barricading. No casualties, event recorded as near miss.
Contractor torqueing bolt at Moran found thread damage, line leaked slightly. Immediate LOTO applied, area secured. No one in line of fire, no injury sustained, classified as near miss.
In rainy conditions at Rangia, blind blind fell during removal from 2 inch line. Dropped on pipe rack, no personnel underneath. Good visibility despite rain, no injury, near miss only.
Employee double-checking isolation at Duliajan heard pop from gasket. Small leak, no fire. Worker used detector, confirmed low levels. No exposure, no injury, near miss situation.

During night shift at Guwahati Depot, flange connection wept during pressure test. H2S alarm went off briefly. Response team arrived, secured area. No one injured, potential event logged as near miss.
Contractor removing spool piece at Jorhat Bypass Road line. Bolt snapped, small leak occurred. Worker was holding tool, not in direct spray path. No injury, near miss due to proximity.
At Digboi, blind stayed in but line depressurized unexpectedly. Hissing sound audible, but no flash fire. PPE was intact. No burn or injury, recorded as near miss.
Morning inspection at Naharkatiya found loose pinch bolt on blind. Gentle leak of hydrocarbon. Area was empty during detection. No injury, potential release prevented, near miss.
While lifting 200kg pipe bundle at Duliajan, tag line snapped due to weak knot causing load swing. Operator's hand crushed between sling and pipe edge, required stitching at on-site clinic.
Contractor rigger at Digboi dropped a 50kg shackle from 3m height during crane load. Shackle struck worker's shin bone, X-ray confirmed hairline fracture, referred to hospital.
At Naharkatiya, crane hook trolley shifted unexpectedly while hoisting tank nozzles. Worker's forearm latched onto falling nozzle edge, deep laceration occurred requiring surgical debridement.
During night shift at Moran, load of valves dropped from 2m height due to slipped eyebolt. Debris struck worker's torso and ribs, treating for multiple bruised ribs and soft tissue injury.
Lumding Terminal crane operator failed to secure load properly. While lowering, steel cable parted and whip back hit rigger's face, causing laceration to left cheek requiring 5 sutures.

Guwahati Depot forklift operator reversed too fast, tipping a heavy drum stack onto a standing supervisor's leg. Significant swelling and abrasions treated, no fracture but hospital observation for 24hrs.
Rangia site witnessed a sudden gust during lifting operation causing load to drift. Worker standing below slipped and fell, resulting in dislocated shoulder and multiple cuts on forearms.
At Jorhat Bypass Road, mobile crane outrigger sunk into soft ground during lift operation. Load shifted abruptly, crushing operator's heel against cab frame, severe contusion and toe injury treated.
Duliajan night shift saw a hoist brake failure mid-air. Load swung into a support structure, ricocheting a metal sheet that cut through PPE, creating deep gash on thigh requiring 12 stitches.
Digboi contractor using improper lifting geometry caused sling to snap. Falling 100kg equipment struck worker's arm, causing complex laceration and tendon damage, underwent minor surgery.

Wire rope part-load snapped during night shift at wellsite, load swung directly over rigger standing below without tag line tension, PTW active but no exclusion zone marked, cleared feet before impact.
Shackle pin ejected under high tension while hoisting pump section, pin struck shoulder of spotter, minor abrasion only but energy release sufficient for amputation if hand had been in path.
Crane slewed unexpectedly due to control fault, hook load passed inches from worker climbing derrick ladder, worker held fast but load path intersected body, no injury recorded.

Lifting sling snagged on pipe rack corner causing violent jerk, pipe bundle tipped towards gas compartment, worker dodged at last second, H2S alarm not yet triggered but potential fatigue release high.
Tag line failed on wind gust during pipe handling, 5ft pipe landed on crane operator cab roof, glass cracked but operator unhurt, high energy impact noted.
Hoist chain kinked and slipped from hook mid-lift, heavy valve body dropped on operator toe, minimal bruising but drop height and mass posed lethal crush risk.
Load shifted during travel on uneven terrain, spool line dropped onto walking rigging crew, three workers jumped clear, one caught boot tip, potential severe crush injury averted.

Swing hook disengaged from sling during boom retraction, hook struck head of signalman working below, helmet absorbed impact but skull fracture potential high, worker shaken but refusal for treatment.
Overhead crossing lifted too high near power line, arc flash risk imminent, load stopped just before contact, worker on ground platform exposed, no electric shock recorded.

Slings not properly rigged for irregular tank shell, load tilted 30 degrees, shell slid and pinned worker between tank and winch base, worker released themselves, no fracture but entrapment near death.
During PTW verification, main blind valve position not confirmed before opening flange. Slight H2S leak detected by portable detector, area secured immediately no one in zone. Shift A

Contractor team removing spade from 2-inch line near Digboi pump array. Gasket failure on re-assembly, minor hydrocarbon mist released. Bystander stepped back, no contact with fluid. Day shift clear sky

Opening of 4-inch feed line at Naharkatiya battery limits. Frangible gasket sheared, high pressure spray directed away from control room. Alarm triggered, LOTO applied. No personnel in immediate spray path
Night shift routine inspection at Moran separator area. Loose packing on bleed valve caused jet stream for seconds. Operator retreated safely, TBT documented. No exposure. Rainy weather
Lumding Terminal truck bay loading arm uncoupling. Seal ring ejected, fuel splash on apron but not on personnel. Driver remained inside cab, HSE officer verified zero contact. Near miss recorded

Guwahati Depot maintenance crew unblinding 6-inch UOP line. Blind flew off due to forgotten bolt torque check. Discharge hit adjacent wall, no worker close enough to be struck. Alarm sounded, area isolated

Rangia refinery inlet valve operation. Gasket blowout created sonic boom and vapor cloud. Crowd evacuation drill initiated, no injuries reported. Wind direction favorable, plume dispersed quickly. Daytime
Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline integrity check. Flange joint weeping escalated to minor jet during pressure test. Contractor isolated section within 30 sec. No one in line of fire. Clear weather

Duliajan flare header maintenance. Spark from welding tool near open flange, caught wisp of gas. Fire detected by IR flame detector, auto-sprinkler activated. Worker safe distance, no alarm on body. Night shift

Naharkatiya dehydration unit. Pressure equalization line spade removal caused misting. Guardrail missing on platform, but worker stood behind barrier. No fall, no splash contact. Recorded as near miss
20 ton crane lifting H2S detector box 15 meters, sling snapped minor during rotation but load swing controlled, no personnel under basket. Near miss logged, PTW suspended for rigging re-check.
Scaffold plank displaced by heavy wind gust at 6 AM, 300mm gap left open. Worker below not impacted but zone not barricaded properly. Immediate stop work issued.
Torque wrench dropped from 4th platform level onto concrete deck. Tool bounced but no one nearby. LOTO not in effect for maintenance, potential crush hazard if floor below active.
Boom of mobile crane grazed isolation barrier while positioning, barrier collapsed onto empty access road. No injuries, but clearance study was inadequate. Contractor crew re-briefed.
Chain hoist over-rotated and cable frayed 10% visible, automatic safety brake engaged. Lift stopped immediately. No load release but near miss flagged for equipment inspection.
Pipe support lifted without tag-out, valve wheel spun unexpectedly. Water spray near operator feet but no slip. SIF not engaged, procedure deviation noted.
Ladder jackier slipped from anchor point while extending basket, harness caught the fall but impact was zero. Anchor point loose, site stopped. TBT training gap identified.
High pressure hose lift from JCB bucket shifted, 5m swing towards valve manifold. Operator cleared area last second. No contact, but shielding absent. Near miss recorded.
Scaffold steel base plate slid on wet surface during assembly, causing 20cm drop of upper frame. No fall of workers. Weather condition ignored in risk assessment.
Hand tool bag dropped from platform edge by contractor, bounced off steel beam and fell 10m. No personnel below but exclusion zone not maintained. PTW violation cited.
Tata truck backing up on Digboi lease road near 2200hr, driver not spotting pedestrian crossing road, stopped just after. No PTW valid for night movement in that zone, near miss.
Mastiff vehicle speeding on Lumding Terminal approach, hit patch of mud and skidded towards fire truck bay. Brake applied late, no collision, fatigue suspected driver was on 4th shift.
Bull on Duliajan-Jorhat link road at dawn, jeep swerved hard to avoid, tire hit shallow ditch. No injury, speed was 60kmph though limit is 40, animal removed by local constable.
Bulldozer reversing near Naharkatiya fence line, operator vision blocked by tree, nearly struck cycle track. Worker walking there shouted, dozer stopped. Spotter not assigned as per plan.
Contractor 6-wheeler on Guwahati Depot perimeter road, driver dozing off, vehicle drifted onto sidewalk. Braked hard, no one there. AC unit not working, fatigue clear warning sign ignored.
Heavy crate truck reversing at Rangia gate, alarm not audiable due to generator noise. Forklift operator stopped inches from reversing truck. LOTO not checked, PTW expired by 10 min.
Jeep on Moran lease road, hit pothole at high speed, jumped up and hit low hanging branch. Glass cracked but no breakage, driver uninjured. Rain slicked surface contributed.
Cow herd on Jorhat Bypass Road, company van tried to overtake, sudden brake led to near skid. Passenger grabbed armrest, no injury. Driver admitted speeding to avoid traffic.
Agri-pump vehicle reversing on Digboi internal road, rear view mirror obstructed by rain. Hit curb, no person in path. Driver fresh on duty but visibility poor due to monsoon.

Truck movement on Duliajan night shift, speed limiter bypassed by previous driver. Current driver found trip log discrepancy, stopped vehicle. No contact with personnel, potential high-energy impact if continued.
Operator reversing K6 truck on lease road near Duliajan, low visibility due to mist, pedestrian was 2 meters away but jumped aside. PTW valid but spotter was not in position, near miss recorded.
Contractor 4x4 speeding past Digboi site gate, tire blew out causing vehicle to swerve towards water separator. No contact with assets or personnel, immediate stop and control restored.
Heavy truck turning on narrow road at Naharkatiya, rear mirror clipped by passing SUV. Driver stopped immediately, no injury to either party, HSE notified.

Locomotive shunting near Moran station, cow wandered onto track. Brakes applied causing drastic stop, steam leak noted but no personnel in path of train. Near miss with potential for derailment if collision occurred.

Manhole cover opened at Lumding Terminal during shift change, maintenance vehicle almost ran over utility worker. Worker stepped back just in time, no injury but high potential for crush injury noted.
Fuel tanker unloading at Guwahati Depot, fire extinguisher cart fell from hitch. Rolled 10 feet towards driver who was stepping out of cab. Driver jumped back, no injury, cart damaged.

Tractor-trailer lifting load at Rangia terminal, cable snapped due to fatigue. Load suspended 20 feet up before safety brake engaged. No personnel in danger zone, but high energy release potential if brake failed.
Bicycle on Jorhat Bypass Road at dusk, employee driving company jeep was distracted by phone. Screeched to stop 5 feet from cyclist. Cyclist unharmed but shaken, near miss recorded for distraction.
Concrete mixer truck reversing on Digboi lease track, earth slumped and blocked path. Driver was forced to stop, no impact with pipeline right-of-way. No injury, site cleanup initiated.

Welding work near Duliajan pump station, neighbor's goat walked into fence and electrocuted. Dog chasing goat ran towards energized panel. Electrician disconnected power instantly, no human contact with energized parts. Near miss for electrocution.
Technician found 5 psi residual pressure in trap during tagging check after LOTO. No PTW violation but alarm raised immediately. Near miss logged.
Contractor opened manhole on line without confirming isolate valve closed. Vapour cloud felt, H2S alarm not triggered. Immediate evacuation and re-verification done.
Spring loaded valve released unexpectedly while mechanic was replacing gasket. Hand grazed by moving stem, no PPE cut. Confirmed energy was not bled off.
During maintenance of actuator, stored energy in piston caused sudden snap-back. Operator stepped aside in time. SIF triggered but no personal injury.
Unisolated pump casing held pressure during de-bolting. Bolt shot out across bay. Worker near miss, shield was only barrier. PTW gap identified.
Residual hydrocarbon mist escaped from drain valve after LOTO verification. Smell detected by nearby operator. Venting protocol missed during handover.
Stored energy in compressed gas header discharged on opening blind. Deafening noise and pressure wave. No injury but safety stand-down called.
Worker trapped between closing gate and vehicle due to unisolated hydraulic brake line. Vehicle jerked forward unexpectedly. TBT almost crushed foot.
Pressure spike observed on gauge after removing blind flange without confirming zero pressure. Hissing sound heard, no injury. Error in isolation sequence.
Contractor accessed confined space with residual nitrogen atmosphere. Crawler alarm activated. Unplanned entry stopped before asphyxiation risk. LOTO not checked.

Contractor found snoring in pump house with open bottle of local brew, PTW active for hot work on adjacent compressor. Immediate unconsciousness risk if fire occurred during sleep, no LOTO observed on intake valve.

Operator reported smelling strong alcohol on night shift at gathering station. Subject approached live high-pressure manifold without face shield, potential for severe eye injury from chemical splashing.
Driver of fuel tanker admitted to consuming sedatives before dawn patrol. Vehicle drift onto pedestrian walkway near loading arm, near-miss collision with active crew, no brake failure confirmed.

Shore crane operator observed disoriented and slurring words during load lift over open tank. Suspended load swung towards bund wall, potential crush hazard if operator lost grip and control entirely.

Maintenance technician found with uncapped chemical drum nearby, suspecting substance use due to nodding off at control panel. Potential exposure to H2S if alarm silence ignored due to impairment, confined space entry attempted without proper PPE.

Employee reported dizziness before operating forklift in depot yard. Forklift tipped slightly while reversing near staircase, potential fall from height if equipment failed completely due to inattentiveness.

Contractor refused breathalyzer at Rangia transfer station, citing personal reasons. Later found sleeping in electrical room with active SIF bypassed, high risk of electrocution or arc flash if equipment faulted during sleep.

Driver of service vehicle lost control on wet bypass road at night. Skidded off tarmac onto embankment, potential rollover if driver had no seatbelt or airbag deployment failed due to prior impairment.

Welder in confined space reported smelling smoke, suspecting solvent fumes mixed with alcohol vapors. Potential explosion or flash fire if oxygen levels not monitored properly due to operator distraction.

Valve operator at Digboi refinery found with empty beer cans in locker, acting aggressively. Attempted forceful closure of steam valve without calling out, potential high-energy steam release causing severe burn injury to nearby colleague.
Welder near storage tank line, spark noticed popping from tank shell before PTW cancelled immediately, no fire started.
Grinding flange on isolation valve, debris flew into gauge cluster but H2S alarm not triggered, worker stepped back safe.
Contractor cutting pipe near manifold, gas detector exceeded limit during work, job halted and area ventilated.
Welding on empty drum inside office yard, wind blew smoke towards electrical panel, breaker tripped before contact.
Hot work permit expired during valve repair, supervisor stopped crew before arc ignited nearby cable insulation.
Plasma cutter tip touched live conductor near pump, arc flash scare but LOTO verified and no burn injury to operator.
Disc grinder shattered at high RPM near pipeline, fragment embedded in protective gear, worker unharmed but PPE replaced.
Welding scaffold near flare line, hot slag fell onto rain-soaked ground causing steam burst, workers evacuated safely.
Oxy-fuel cutting on tank roof, pressure drop in branch line detected, work stopped to prevent air ingress and explosion.
Drilling anchor bolts near hydrant, hammer strike hit hidden hydraulic line, spray hit face shield but no injury.
Crane hook swinging close to operator during load swing at 10 AM, cleared by spotter in time.
Falling bolt from 12m scaffold near walkway, PTW valid but tie-off missed, no one below.
Suspension scaffold drifted off anchor point during high wind, corrected immediately by team.
Lifting lug cracked during pre-lift inspection, load grounded, tooling replaced before start.
Worker used rope as part of lift sling, inspected and found flaw, removed from service.
Overhead cable interference during boom rotation, lift paused, re-rigged with clearance check.
TBT line snagged on untagged valve, load suspended 3 seconds, no damage or injury.
Contractor placed loose hand tool on elevated platform edge, swept off by wind, caught by barrier.
Crane outrigger on soft soil sunk slightly, lift aborted, mats laid and re-checked.
H2S alarm triggered during hot work near suspended tank, personnel evacuated, no exposure.
Contractor climbed 4.5m platform without harness while coating pipe, slipped and landed on lower tray, right ankle sprained severely, sent to field clinic, no PTW valid for height work.
Rooftop AC unit maintenance in progress, ladder rung broke under load, worker fell 2m onto gravel, cut on left palm requiring sutures, LOTO done but edge protection missing.
Scaffold plank shifted during tightening, inspector stepped back, fell 3m, abrasions and bruised ribs, medically treated, shift change handover gap noted, wind high.
Employee on 6m ladder for valve inspection, lost grip on rung, fell to platform 1.2m below, dislocated shoulder, reduced in field hospital, no fall arrest gear worn.
Pump house roof work, rain started suddenly, worker slipped on wet metal, fell 3m, fractured wrist, emergency vehicle called, scaffold was not rated for wet conditions.
During flare stack inspection, contractor climbed fixed ladder without safety cage, foot slipped, fell 5m, lacerations and contusions, treated at onsite clinic, HSE violation logged.
Working on 2m high railing for painting, lean-back caused loss of balance, worker dropped 1.5m, soft tissue injury to knee, required physiotherapy, no permit for confined/height overlap.
Ladder extended too high onto maintenance gantry, top rung slipped off edge, worker on 3rd rung fell 2m, fractured forearm, hospital transferred, ladder not secured at top.
Night shift, low visibility, employee climbed portable ladder to check gauge, rain made rungs slippery, fell 2.5m, cut on shin and bruised thigh, first aid exceeded, medical visit.
Scaffold tower unbalanced during assembly, worker on 2nd level stepped onto loose tie, fell 1.8m, abrasions and minor concussion, checked in clinic, no sign-off for stability check.
